baseband_channel_decoding.actual_payload_observation: radar_I/radar_Q present; B3-B6 individual fields not present

missing_data_behavior.optional_ecg_pcg_failure: warning only; native radar/respiration adapter remains separately auditable

output_sampling_rate: same as source file Fs; no resampling in D1

output_signals.meaning: source-defined relative distance change; absolute offset unknown
output_signals.name: relative_displacement_m

reference_channel.name: respiration
reference_channel.sample_alignment: same source sample index and Fs as radar channels

source_intrinsic_corrections.ellipse_correction: required by publication before demodulation; deterministic full-recording algebraic ellipse fit
source_intrinsic_corrections.offset_correction: ellipse-fit center correction only, retained as fit metadata
source_intrinsic_corrections.published_code_audit_limit: ellipseReconstruction implementation is MATLAB P-code; transparent adapter fit is documented and tested here

source_sampling_rate.contract_rule: use per-recording Fs; reject unsupported/nonfinite values; never infer from array length

timestamp_generation_rule: time_s[i] = i / Fs, i=0..N-1; recording timestamp remains provenance metadata; no per-sample timestamp exists
unwrap_rule: atan2(corrected_Q, corrected_I) followed by adjacent-sample 2*pi phase unwrapping
